paragraphs: The GLE53 AMG sits at the performance end of the GLE-Class range, using AMG's version of the M256 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid assistance. It's been fitted since the V167 generation launched in 2019, and remains in production today. The Coupe body style was added in 2021, but the engine itself is the same across both body styles.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLE53 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLE53 AMG from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
